records.gold_sql: WITH ranked_recipients AS ( SELECT naics_description, recipient_name, SUM(federal_action_obligation) AS total_obligation, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY naics_description ORDER BY SUM(federal_action_obligation) DESC) AS rnk FROM award_transactions GROUP BY naics_description, recipient_name ) SELECT naics_description, recipient_name, total_obligation, rnk FROM ranked_recipients

WITH recipient_obligations AS (
